definitions.explanation: the ability to perceive the true nature of things or understand situations deeply

examples.japanese: {洞察力|どうさつりょく}が{鋭|するど}い。
{洞察力|どうさつりょく}のある{分析|ぶんせき}だった。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{人|ひと}の{心|こころ}を{見抜|みぬ}く{洞察力|どうさつりょく}がある。
examples.english: She has the insight to see through people's hearts.

examples.japanese: {優|すぐ}れた{洞察力|どうさつりょく}で{問題|もんだい}の{本質|ほんしつ}を{見抜|みぬ}いた。
examples.english: With excellent insight, he perceived the essence of the problem.

notes:
USAGE:
Refers to deep perception and understanding that goes beyond surface appearances. Valued in analytical and leadership roles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく}が{鋭|するど}い - to have sharp insight
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく}に{富|と}む - to be rich in insight
- {洞察力|どうさつりょく}を{養|やしな}う - to cultivate insight

RELATED ABILITIES:
- {観察力|かんさつりょく} - observation skills
- {分析力|ぶんせきりょく} - analytical ability
- {直感力|ちょっかんりょく} - intuition
